items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I've known Raymond for years. He's come around my house... I go to his house

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. A lot of musicians don't own a record.

Well, I do. As a matter of fact, I had a lot of records. Raymond Boyd, you know, Raymond Will. I've known Raymond for years. He's come around my house. He says, you got some nice records in town? I said, yeah, I had a record box. Big Spider-Bank, Wolverine Band, Tylan Blues, Roy Gordon, all those records. He's come to my house, see. I said, big record box full of records, see, and arranged to come around and hear my records, see. I go to his house, see. And you know, I thought that doesn't get any recognition in…
I've heard many, many musicians say that, and I don't think that the general public understood what he was doing. Very tough, man. Tops.
